Q. With reference to the 'Startup India' initiative as of its 10th anniversary in January 2026, which of the following statements is/are correct? 1. The National Startup Day is celebrated on 16th January. # Page 9^page=9
Q. With reference to the updated 'NPS Vatsalya Scheme Guidelines 2025' issued by PFRDA, consider the following statements: (i) The scheme is a Central Sector Scheme where the minimum initial and annual contribution is ₹250. (ii) In the event of a guardian's demise, the account is automatically closed and the accumulated corpus is paid to the minor's bank account. (iii) Partial withdrawals are permitted for education or medical reasons limited to a maximum of three occasions before the age of 18 and an additional two occasions between the ages of 18 and 21. (iv) Upon reaching the age of 18, a subscriber can exit the scheme if the total accumulated corpus is ₹8 lakh or less. (v) If a subscriber attains the age of 21 without choosing an exit or transition option, the account is deemed to have shifted to a high-risk equity-oriented variant under the Multiple Scheme Framework (MSF). Which of the statements given above are correct? A) Only (i), (iii), and (iv) B) Only (i), (iv), and (v) C) Only (i), (iii), (iv), and (v) D) Only (iii), (iv), and (v) E) All of the above (i, ii, iii, iv, and v)
